title: Microsoft Edge: Select Password option in the right-click menu
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap details, feature behaviour and all six control paths and registry references are supported. Two minor clarifications remain: describe PasswordManagerEnabled by its documented reach and include the authentication prompt frequency for PrimaryPasswordSetting.

claims.claim: The option gives users manual access to saved credentials when automatic suggestions do not appear.

claims.claim: The Beta Channel release notes list Select Password from the context menu under Version 159.0.4402.7.
claims.quote:
## Version 159.0.4402.7: November 19, 2026
### Feature updates
- **Select Password from the context menu.** Users can now manually access saved credentials when password suggestions don't appear automatically.

claims.quote: Searched: Select Password entry in Beta release notes, including its full action list and surrounding paragraphs; only saved credentials and existing Edge Password Manager surfaces are named.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: The Select Password release notes do not state an authentication requirement before filling.
claims.quote: Searched: "Select Password" "policy" "Edge"; read Beta feature entry and PrimaryPasswordSetting. The feature entry specifies OS authentication for viewing details, not filling; the policy page describes autofill generally.

claims.claim: The release-notes entry describes no automatic action by the Select Password option.
claims.quote: Searched: full Select Password entry in Beta release notes for automatic actions; it describes right-click access and user-selected search, fill, view and manage actions, not an autonomous action.

claims.claim: The release notes describe the listed options as available to users with saved credentials.

claims.claim: The feature release-notes entry names no required role.
claims.quote: Searched: full Select Password entry in Beta release notes for a required role; it names users with saved credentials and says no configuration is required, with no role requirement.

claims.claim: The Group Policy path is Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Password manager and protection > Enable saving passwords to the password manager.
claims.quote:
### Group Policy (ADMX) info
- GP name: Enable saving passwords to the password manager
- GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge/Password manager and protection

claims.claim: The registry control is SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, value PasswordManagerEnabled.
claims.quote:
### Registry settings
- Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge
- Value name: PasswordManagerEnabled
- Value type: REG\_DWORD

claims.claim: PasswordManagerEnabled governs saving new passwords in Edge.
claims.quote: Enable Microsoft Edge to save user passwords. ... If you disable this policy, users can't save and add new passwords, but they can still use previously saved passwords.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: Disabling PasswordManagerEnabled still permits users to use previously saved passwords.
claims.quote: If you disable this policy, users can't save and add new passwords, but they can still use previously saved passwords.

claims.claim: PasswordManagerEnabled is not documented as governing this option.
claims.quote: If you disable this policy, users can't save and add new passwords, but they can still use previously saved passwords.
claims.fix: Remove 'Not documented as governing this option.' from controls[0].note and its matching table note. Keep 'Existing policy. When disabled, users can still use previously saved passwords.' as supported by https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-policies/passwordmanagerenabled.

claims.claim: PasswordManagerEnabled is a user/profile-level control.
claims.quote:
## Supported features
- Per Profile: Yes

claims.claim: The Group Policy path is Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Password manager and protection > Configure the list of domains for which the password manager UI (Save and Fill) will be disabled.
claims.quote:
GP name: Configure the list of domains for which the password manager UI (Save and Fill) will be disabled
- GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge/Password manager and protection

claims.claim: PasswordManagerBlocklist uses registry key SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge\PasswordManagerBlocklist with numbered values 1, 2, 3.
claims.quote:
### Registry settings
- Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge\PasswordManagerBlocklist
- Value name: 1, 2, 3, ...
- Value type: List of REG\_SZ

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: PasswordManagerBlocklist disables password-manager Save and Fill workflows for configured domains.
claims.quote: Configure the list of domains where Microsoft Edge should disable the password manager. This means that Save and Fill workflows are disabled, ensuring that passwords for those websites can't be saved or auto filled into web forms.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Users cannot use the password manager for the URLs configured in PasswordManagerBlocklist.
claims.quote: If you configure this policy, that is, add domains for which password manager is blocked, users can't change or override the behavior in Microsoft Edge. In addition, users can't use password manager for those URLs.

claims.claim: PasswordManagerBlocklist is supported on Windows and macOS, not Android or iOS.
claims.quote:
## Supported versions
- Windows: ≥ 99
- macOS: ≥ 99
- Android: Not supported
- iOS: Not supported

claims.claim: PasswordManagerBlocklist is a user/profile-level control.
claims.quote:
## Supported features
- Per Profile: Yes

claims.claim: The Group Policy path is Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Password manager and protection > Configures a setting that asks users to enter their device password while using password autofill.
claims.quote:
GP name: Configures a setting that asks users to enter their device password while using password autofill
- GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge/Password manager and protection

claims.claim: The registry control is SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, value PrimaryPasswordSetting.
claims.quote:
### Registry settings
- Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge
- Value name: PrimaryPasswordSetting
- Value type: REG\_DWORD

claims.where: controls[2].governs, note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: WithDevicePassword requires users to prove their identity through device authentication before a saved password is autofilled.
claims.quote: If you set this policy to 'WithDevicePassword', users have to enter their device password (or preferred mode of authentication under Windows) to prove their identity before their password is autofilled.
claims.fix: Add to controls[2].note and its matching table note: 'The prompt frequency defaults to Ask permission once per browsing session; users can change it to Always ask permission.' This qualification is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-policies/primarypasswordsetting.

- iOS: Not supported

claims.quote:
